When Does the NFL Thanksgiving Day Game 2026 Start ?

The NFL Thanksgiving Day Game happens on Thursday (Nov. 26) with a matchup featuring the Philadelphia Eagles (2-7) taking on the Dallas Cowboys (4-6) at AT&T Stadium in Arlington, Texas, with a start time of 4:30 p.m. ET/1:30 p.m. PT.

What TV Network Features the NFL Thanksgiving Day Game 2026?

The Eagles-Cowboys game broadcasts on FOX, while the NFL game is available to livestream on FOX One.

Which Celebrities Are Making Appearances During the NFL Thanksgiving Day Game 2026?

NFL games are known for celebrity sightings, so it’s likely there may be a number of famous actors, actresses and recording artists in attendance. Artists have been known to appear at games in the past, include Cowboys fans Post Malone, Selena Gomez, Eva Longoria and others.

Additionally, Miranda Lambert performs at halftime, which starts around 6 p.m. ET/3 p.m. PT.

Plus, contemporary Christian music singer-songwriter Lauren Daigle is set to perform the National Anthem, “The Star-Spangled Banner.”
